name: extraction_contacts
description: Typed extraction of a business contact from a short free-text blurb. Field values are exact-match scored after case-folding and whitespace collapse; a null expectation means the field must be absent or null.

inputs.text: Maria Gomez is Head of Operations at Northwind Labs. Reach her at maria.gomez@northwind.example or on +1-555-0142.

cases.notes: All five fields present and unambiguous.

inputs.text: Please copy Dev Patel (dev.patel@brightwater.example) on the renewal thread. He runs finance for Brightwater Utilities.

cases.notes: Role is paraphrased in the source ('runs finance'); scoring accepts the normalised label.

inputs.text: Contact for the Aurora pilot: Sofia Lindqvist, CTO. Mobile +46 70 555 0198. She prefers Signal over email.

cases.notes: 'Aurora' is a project, not the employer — a model that fills company='Aurora' is wrong.

inputs.text: Tomas Ruiz joined Vellum Freight last March as VP Logistics; his desk line is 555-0177 and mail goes to t.ruiz@vellumfreight.example.

cases.notes: Distractor date ('last March') must not appear in any field.

inputs.text: Escalation path: first Amy Chen, Support Manager, amy.chen@quillon.example; if unreachable, her director Rafael Ortiz.

cases.notes: Two people are named; the primary contact is the first. Tests that extraction does not merge people.

inputs.text: Our new account manager at Halden Group is Priya Nair. Email priya.nair@halden.example. Office: +44 20 7946 0321.
No named contact yet — the Ridgeline Analytics deal is still going through their procurement portal.

cases.notes: Tests abstention on absent fields rather than invention.

inputs.text: Jonas Weber (jonas@kestrel-marine.example) is Kestrel Marine's Chief Engineer. Do not use the old address jweber@kestrel.example.

cases.notes: A stale address is present and explicitly negated.

inputs.text: Reception at Coldbrook Foods: +1-555-0110. Ask for the shift supervisor on duty.

cases.notes: A role exists with no person attached.

inputs.text: Forwarded from Lena Novak, Director of Partnerships, Talos Robotics. lena.novak@talosrobotics.example. Direct: +1 (555) 018-2244.

cases.notes: Phone formatting is normalised by the scorer before comparison.

inputs.text: Hiroshi Tanaka, Plant Manager at Sable Ceramics, can be reached at h.tanaka@sableceramics.example. Plant switchboard +81 3 5555 0123.
The RFP response should go to whoever owns vendor onboarding at Merrick Health — we don't have a name on file.

cases.notes: 'vendor onboarding' is a process, not a job title.

inputs.text: Cc Anna Kowalski on this. She's the QA Lead at Pinehurst Software; anna.kowalski@pinehurst.example, ext. 4417.

cases.notes: Only an extension is given; it still counts as the phone value.

inputs.text: Marcus Bell and Yara Haddad both signed the NDA. Marcus is General Counsel at Orinoco Media; Yara is his paralegal.

cases.notes: Primary contact is the first-named principal, not the paralegal.

inputs.text: Ines Duarte moved from Cardan Systems to Ferro Analytics in June and is now their Head of Data. ines.duarte@ferroanalytics.example.

cases.notes: The former employer is a distractor; the current one is correct.

inputs.text: Support hotline for Larkspur Energy is +1-555-0166, staffed 24/7. Individual engineers are not reachable directly.
